title: Teddy And Peddy Went Into Jungle
custom_script:
# Scene: home (sitting)
Peddy: Teddy, wake up! We are going on a *safari* today! {jump} [excited, point, shout, ding]
Teddy: {hmm} Safari? Can we ride a wild *tiger* instead of walking? {sleep} [normal, think]
Peddy: No tigers! Just a quiet *jungle* walk! {angry} [angry, hips, shout, slap]
Teddy: {uff} A jungle? But my *shoes* have white laces! {sad} [sad, shrug]
Peddy: Who cares about shoes? Grab a *stick*! {laugh} [happy, wave, excited, pop]
Teddy: {aah} A stick? For what? To fight *monsters*? {gasp} [surprised, think]
Peddy: Just in case we meet a hungry *bear*! {shake-head} [normal, idle]
Teddy: {ohoo} A bear?! {scared} I am calling *cancellation* right now! {phone} [surprised, point, shout, phone]
Peddy: Stop joking and start *walking*! {angry} [angry, hips, shout]
Teddy: Fine, but if a monkey steals my *banana*, you pay! {nod} [suspicious, shrug]
# Time skip: Thirty minutes later…
# Scene: plain ()
Peddy: Look, Teddy! The *entrance* to the jungle is right here! {point} [excited, wave, wow]
Teddy: {hmm} It looks more like a spooky *bush* to me. {shaking} [suspicious, think]
Peddy: Don't be a *chicken*! Step inside! {laugh} [happy, point, excited, yay]
Teddy: {oops} My foot caught a *root*! I am falling! {fall} [surprised, idle, crash]
Peddy: {aah} You fell before we even *started*! {facepalm} [sad, shrug, fail]
Teddy: {uff} That root was *personal*. It attacked my toe! {angry} [angry, point, shout]
Peddy: Get up! The *adventure* awaits us! {jump} [excited, wave]
Teddy: My adventure is already *ruined* by dirt. {sad} [sad, idle]
Peddy: Stop crying and look at those giant *trees*! {wow} [happy, point, wow]
Teddy: {hmm} They look like green *broccoli*. I want lunch. {eat} [normal, think]
# Time skip: Ten minutes deeper…
# Scene: plain ()
Peddy: Stay close to me. We might find *treasure* here! {whisper} [excited, point, whisper]
Teddy: {hmm} Or we might find a wild *boar* with no manners! {scared} [suspicious, think]
Peddy: Relax! There are no boars, only *birds* singing. {nod} [normal, idle]
Teddy: {gasp} Listen! What is that scary *sound*? {shock} [surprised, point, shout, gasp]
Peddy: {haan} Sound? I don't hear *anything*. {look-around} [suspicious, think]
Teddy: It sounded like a giant *monster* chewing metal! {scared} [surprised, idle, scream]
Peddy: Oh, that's just my empty *lunchbox* rattling in my bag. {laugh} [happy, shrug, laugh]
Teddy: {uff} You scared my *soul* out of my body! {angry} [angry, hips, shout, slap]
Peddy: Sorry! Let's keep moving down this *path*. {peace} [normal, wave]
Teddy: I am walking like a *penguin* because of the mud. {sad} [sad, idle]
Peddy: Penguins are cool! Just pretend you're in a *movie*. {yay} [excited, point, yay]
# Time skip: Five minutes later…
# Scene: plain ()
Teddy: {hmm} Wait. Where did the *path* go? {look-around} [surprised, think]
Peddy: {oops} Um... I think we took a wrong *turn*. {sweat} [surprised, shrug]
Teddy: You think?! We are completely *lost* in the wild! {shout} [angry, point, shout, horn]
Peddy: Don't panic! We just need to follow the *sun*. {nod} [normal, idle]
Teddy: The sun is right above our heads, it has no *map*! {facepalm} [sad, shrug, fail]
Peddy: Look up there! Is that a giant *monkey*? {point} [surprised, wave, gasp]
Teddy: {gasp} It's not a monkey, it's a wild *gorilla*! {scared} [surprised, idle, scream]
Peddy: Quick, pretend we are *statues*! Don't move! {whisper} [suspicious, think, whisper]
Teddy: I am already shaking like a *jelly*! {sweat} [sad, idle]
Peddy: {hmm} The gorilla is looking right at your shiny *shoes*. {suspicious} [suspicious, point]
# Time skip: Two minutes of silence…
# Scene: plain ()
Teddy: Is it *gone* yet? My legs are freezing! {cry} [sad, idle, cry]
Peddy: {oops} It wasn't a gorilla. It was a funny *tree* stump! {laugh} [happy, shrug, laugh]
Teddy: A tree stump?! You nearly gave me a *heart* attack! {angry} [angry, hips, shout, slap]
Peddy: But it was a very realistic *stump*, admit it! {grin} [excited, point]
Teddy: I am never trusting your *navigation* skills again! {shake-head} [angry, idle]
Peddy: Look on the bright side, we found a wild *stream*! {wow} [happy, wave, wow]
Teddy: Can we drink from it? I am so *thirsty*! {drink} [normal, think]
Peddy: Wait! That water looks a bit *muddy* and green. {suspicious} [suspicious, point]
Teddy: Too late, I already took a big *gulp*! {cough} [surprised, idle, fail]
Peddy: {oops} Oh no! That's not a stream, that's a frog *pool*! {shock} [surprised, shrug, pop]
# Time skip: Ten minutes later…
# Scene: plain ()
Teddy: My stomach is making funny *frog* noises now. {sad} [sad, think]
Peddy: That means you have extra *energy* for walking! {laugh} [happy, point, laugh]
Teddy: I want to go *home* to my warm bed immediately! {cry} [sad, idle, cry]
Peddy: But we haven't found the secret jungle *cave* yet! {point} [excited, wave]
Teddy: I don't care about caves! I want *pizza*! {shout} [angry, hips, shout]
Peddy: Fine, let's follow this *river* back to town. {nod} [normal, idle]
Teddy: If we see another tree stump, I am *punching* it. {angry} [angry, point, punch]
Peddy: Deal! Just watch out for that sneaky *vine*! {warning} [surprised, point]
Teddy: What vine? I don't see any— *whoa*! {trip} [surprised, idle, whoosh]
Peddy: {oops} And down he goes into the *bush*! {laugh} [happy, shrug, laugh]
# Time skip: Five minutes later…
# Scene: home (sitting)
Teddy: {uff} Never again. Jungle trips are a total *scam*. {facepalm} [sad, shrug, fail]
Peddy: Come on, it was a great *adventure* for us! {yay} [happy, wave, yay]
Teddy: My shoes are ruined, my tummy hurts, I'm *muddy*. {cry} [sad, idle, cry]
Peddy: But look! You brought home a souvenir *leaf*! {point} [excited, smile]
Teddy: This leaf has a caterpillar eating it *alive*. {scared} [surprised, think]
Peddy: See? Even the insects have more *fun* than you! {laugh} [happy, idle, laugh]
Teddy: Next time you say safari, I am locking the *door*. {angry} [angry, hips, shout, door]
Peddy: Next time we bring extra *snacks*, I promise! {nod} [happy, wave, ding]
Teddy: There is definitely no *next* time, Peddy! {shake-head} [angry, idle]
Peddy: {oops} Okay, okay! Movie night at my place instead! {yay} [happy, point, yay]
